one_month_reasoning: Window 2026-10-30 to 2026-11-29 holds no TT earnings (Q4 due ~late Jan 2027), only industrial conferences (Baird, early-mid Nov), a likely dividend declaration and macro prints. The stock already fell 8.6% (448.47 -> 410) on the reaffirmed EPS guide implying Q4 ~3.40-3.50 vs Street 3.59; Street revisions down toward the guide are a mild headwind, offset by short-horizon reversal after a sharp two-day drop and supportive hyperscaler 2027 capex commentary (Alphabet, Amazon, 2026-10-30). Net: median ~409, monthly vol 30%/3.5 = 8.6% with slightly fat tails; ladder unchanged from round 1 (the supervisor's findings move the 12-month value, not the next month's events).

fair_value.method: Quarterly backlog-burn driver build tied to the dated backlog (FY2027 revenue 26.8B, GAAP EBIT 4.91B; FY2028 28.7B, 5.36B) valued at the horizon on NTM model EPS ~19.1 x 22.3x P/E (weight 0.75, $423.33) and LTM GAAP EBITDA x 18.9x (0.25, $440.62), less net debt incl. supplier finance, NCI at market and the asbestos top-up.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: NTM (Nov 2027-Oct 2028) model NOPAT less interest on horizon net debt ~3.08B / 216.7M shares = ~19.1 EPS x 22.3x (6-peer median 18.3x shrunk with k=0.8 from own 23.48x; no extra haircut), less NCI 489 and asbestos 275 (-$3.5/share)

inputs_detail.derivation: Actuals from releases (2025: 5,283/5,626/5,979/5,760; 2026: 6,691/7,818/7,248). Q4 2026 6,620 = Q4 2025 5,760 x 1.15. FY2027 6,850+7,200+7,300+6,950 = 28,300 (-0.3% vs FY2026 28,377; raised from round-1 27,900): CEO on the Q3 call 'not concerned about orders slowing... the pipeline continues to grow', timing is 'lumpiness'; Alphabet/Amazon guide 2027 capex up significantly (HL/Business Insider, 2026-10-30); offset by the +39% Q2 2026 comp. FY2028 29,600 (+4.6%).

inputs_detail.derivation: bl_q = bl_(q-1) + bk_q - revenue_q / 0.985 (slip calibrated on 2025-26 quarters). Revenue path is a dated backlog burn: CFO says >$8B of the $12.5B Q3-2026 backlog is for 2027 and beyond, of which >$1B for 2028, so ~$4.4B ships in Q4 2026 and ~$7.0B in 2027 from the Q3 backlog; add ~$2.3B of Q4-2026 bookings dated 2027 (~35% of 6,620, long-cycle applied share) = ~$9.3B from backlog; in-year book-and-ship ~$17.5B (FY2026 ~16.7B = revenue 24,233 less ~7.5B shipped from the 8.8B start backlog incl. ~1B Stellar; +5% on services and normalised residential channel) -> FY2027 revenue ~26.8B (5,680/6,850/7,340/6,930). FY2028 28,700 (6,150/7,350/7,800/7,400): ~70% of the end-2027 backlog (~9.8B) plus ~18.9B in-year. Backlog ends 2027 at ~14.0B and 2028 at ~14.4B (~50% of revenue): conversion is capacity-paced (applied capacity expanded four times in three years, Facilities Dive).
inputs_detail.variant_view: Faster conversion (more capacity, backlog burns to ~45% of revenue): FY2027 revenue ~27.2B (round-1 path), ~+3% value.

inputs_detail.derivation: Quarter actuals = Americas segment operating income / revenue. Q4 2026 17.7% (Q4 2025 17.1%; call: Q4 price ~2pt in Americas; model Q4 adjusted EPS ~3.48 inside the call's ~3.40-3.50). FY2027 +35bp per quarter vs 2026 (round 1 +40bp): leverage cut to 'low 20s' in 2026 from 25%+, price ~1pt; for 2027 management plans price over inflation of 20-30bp and a return to the 25%+ algorithm, which TT missed in 2026, so we sit between (enterprise GAAP incrementals ~23% FY2027). FY2028 +30bp.
inputs_detail.variant_view: TT delivers the 25%+ algorithm in 2027 (+60bp Americas): ~+3% value; persistent negative price/cost: -250bp in the downside case.

inputs_detail.derivation: 9M 2026 ETR 574.4 / 3,184.2 = 18.0%; Q4 2026 carries a $0.10/share tax headwind (call), ~ $22M on ~$1.0B pretax, ~+2pt in Q4 -> FY2026 ~18.7%; FY2025 705.9 / 3,678.6 = 19.2%; FY2027-28 19.0% (Q3 2026 17.1% was a one-off benefit). Raised from 18.0/18.5/19.0 on the supervisor's tax finding.
inputs_detail.variant_view: Pillar Two / Irish rate changes add 1-2pt: -1-2% value.

inputs_detail.derivation: Whole-company peer median NTM P/E 18.3x of six (LII 14.2, CARR 16.9, SPXC 17.1, Daikin 19.5, AAON 22.8, JCI 23.7; median (17.1+19.5)/2). Daikin CY-aligned: 5/12 x FY3/27 EPS 996.1 + 7/12 x FY3/28 1,150 = 1,085.9 JPY; 21,170 / 1,085.9 = 19.5x (MarketScreener). CSWI dropped (consumables). TT own NTM P/E = 410 / 17.46 = 23.48x (Nasdaq quarterly consensus: 2/3 x Q4'26 3.59 + Q1-Q3'27 3.15+5.02+5.49 + 1/3 x Q4'27 4.22 = 17.46). Exit = 18.3 x (23.48/18.3)^0.8 = 18.3 x 1.2207 = 22.34 -> 22.3x. inputs_detail.variant_view: Supervisor's quarterly-consensus peer median 18.45x / own 23.96x gives 22.7x: +1.8% value. A -0.5x haircut for post-horizon risk would be -2%.

inputs_detail.derivation: 9M 2026 net earnings attributable to NCI 20.0 (10-Q) x 4/3 = 26.7/yr x whole-company peer median NTM P/E 18.3x = 26.67 x 18.3 = 488.0. Book NCI 22.8 understates the claim; as an equity adjustment it hits both legs (model EPS excludes NCI).

methods.name: EV/EBITDA
methods.inputs: LTM at horizon GAAP EBITDA ~5.26B x 18.9x, less horizon net debt ~3.08B (incl. supplier finance), NCI and asbestos adjustments, / 216.7M shares

inputs_detail.derivation: TTM D&A 406.9 / TTM revenue 23,227.1 = 1.75%.

Total debt 4,217.6 (F93) - cash 1,227.4 (10-Q) = 2,990.2, plus supplier-finance obligations 393.1 carried in accounts payable (10-Q Note 7) treated as debt per the playbook trap = 3,383.3. Operating leases excluded (as in peer EV).

Whole-company peers with a usable filing-based trailing EV/EBITDA: LII 11.5x, SPXC 16.7x, median 14.1x (CSWI dropped; CARR 279.6x tag artifact; JCI/AAON blank). TT own = (410 x 218.9 + 3,383.3) / 4,569.4 = 93,132 / 4,569.4 = 20.38x. Exit 14.1 x (20.38/14.1)^0.8 = 14.1 x 1.343 = 18.93 -> 18.9x; no extra haircut.
inputs_detail.variant_view: Only two trailing peers; weight held at 0.25.

downside.story: 10th percentile: data-center/applied orders pause (bookings -8% vs base every quarter, book-to-bill <1 in 2027, FY2027 revenue ~+2%; Microsoft already cites third-party data-center delays), price/cost stays negative so Americas margin -250bp and international -200bp, and the P/E de-rates 3.5 turns to ~18.8x, the peer median.

base.story: Median: the dated backlog burns as the CFO laid out (~$9.3B of FY2027 revenue from backlog, FY2027 +10.6%, FY2028 +7.1%), bookings flat in 2027 against the +39% Q2 comp, incrementals ~23% (below the 25%+ framework), FY2027 adjusted EPS ~17.7 (Street 17.71, whisper 18.10); the exit P/E shrinks to 22.3x by rule.

upside.story: 90th percentile: hyperscalers spend 'significantly more' in 2027 (Alphabet, Amazon) and orders grow (+6% vs base), capacity lifts conversion, price/cost turns positive (+120bp Americas, +100bp international) and the P/E holds ~25.8x, near VRT.

reasoning: Round 2. Supervisor findings accepted: Daikin's NTM P/E is 19.5x CY-aligned (5/12 x 996.1 + 7/12 x 1,150 JPY at 21,170), not 21.8x (round 1 blended the wrong fiscal years); CSWI out of the whole-company set, so the 6-peer median is 18.3x (peers.md basis); own NTM P/E re-measured on Nasdaq quarterly consensus (17.46 -> 23.48x); exit 22.3x by the k=0.8 rule, and the -0.5x long-dated haircut removed as a double count. Revenue is now tied to a dated backlog burn from the Q3 call (>$8B of $12.5B for 2027+, >$1B for 2028): ~$9.3B of FY2027 revenue from backlog plus ~$17.5B book-and-ship gives 26.8B (+10.6%) vs 27.2B in round 1; bookings flat in 2027 (CEO: pipeline still growing, orders lumpy; Alphabet/Amazon signal significantly higher 2027 capex), so backlog keeps rising slowly. Americas margin +35bp in 2027 (between the 2026 'low 20s' leverage and the 25%+ plan), tax 18.7/19/19 on the Q4 tax headwind, NWC 6% from 2027. Bridge fixed: supplier finance 393.1 in net debt, NCI at market (-489) and the asbestos trust top-up (-275) as adjustments; I do not include the supervisor's extra asbestos 'court estimate' because the 10-K discloses no estimated amount. FY2027 adjusted EPS ~17.7 (Street 17.71, whisper 18.10), FY2028 ~19.75 (Street 20.41, -3%). Research target (12m) 427.65 (round 1 449.48). Scenarios move bookings and margins as the playbook says, with -3.5/+3.5 turns; left tail fatter. Lane: hyperscaler capex coverage, trade press on capacity, CBRE/JLL construction data; forum lead-time anecdote stays out of the numbers. Limits: X/Twitter not fetched; about 7 follow-up queries this round.
